title: Mixture of Experts
motto: A dense 70B transformer activates every parameter for every token. A 671B MoE activates only 37B per token and beats it on every benchmark. Sparsity is the most important scaling idea of the decade.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: A dense 70B transformer activates every parameter for every token. A 671B MoE activates only 37B per token and beats it on every benchmark. Sparsity is the most important scaling idea of the decade.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: A dense transformer's FLOPs at inference equal its parameter count (times 2 for forward pass). Scale up a dense model and every token pays the full bill. By 2024 the frontier was hitting a compute wall: to be meaningfully smarter, you needed exponentially more FLOPs per token.

Mixture of Experts breaks this link. Replace each FFN with `E` independent experts + a router that picks `k` experts per token. Total parameters = `E × FFN_size`. Active parameters per token = `k × FFN_size`. Typical 2026 configuration: `E=256`, `k=8`. Storage scales with `E`, compute scales with `k`.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Route tokens to top-k experts. Sparse activation scales parameters.

steps.title: Implement moe
steps.body: Write the function from scratch in the workspace. Run when ready — all tests must pass.

code.starter:
def active_params(total, k, n_experts):
    return total*k//n_experts
